_readme: Curated recognition for Boston restaurants - sources with no public API.
One entry = one source vouching for one restaurant. A restaurant on two lists has two entries.
Fields: name, address, source (an id from SOURCES in restaurants/scoring.py), source_url, note (edition / date checked).

Optional: price (1-4, the source's own $ rating) and cuisine (a key from restaurants/cuisines.py) - used when map data lacks them. Michelin entries carry Michelin's; 'Contemporary' has no cuisine key, so it is left empty.
place_id / lat / lon are filled in by: python -m restaurants.tools.enrich_recognition
Every entry was copied from the source page itself; never add an award from memory. See restaurants/README.md, 'Adding recognition entries'.
Lists change: Eater 38 updates quarterly, Michelin yearly. Re-check and update the note when you do.
